decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler builds directly on the firm's core heat-exchange knowledge, so its own R&D and testing facilities let management interpret market feedback and refine the product rather than abandon it.
The air cooled condenser draws on deep existing condenser competence and fits the efficiency and lower-emission strategy, though its overlap with Product C keeps some chance of consolidation.
This second single-tube condenser is easy for the firm to absorb and improve, but its redundancy with Product B makes it the more likely candidate if the portfolio is streamlined.
The customized industrial air cooler line embodies the firm's integrated-solution strategy and rests on broad existing competence across several models, so it is very unlikely to be withdrawn.

Tube end repair inserts complement the service and spare-parts business and use proven heat-exchanger knowledge, although the withdrawal of the related tube liner signals some fragility in tube-repair products.
